summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with Dato Ling Tiung Leng for a MYR 500 million (~US$126 million) capital injection. The company will issue ~9 million Class A shares at $14.10 per share, resulting in Dato Ling holding a 65% equity stake. Proceeds are earmarked for AI data center construction in Malaysia. The injection is tranched with shares issued per tranche based on the prevailing USD exchange rate. Completion is subject to customary conditions. This is a private investment transaction, not a public tender or going-private event; watch for tranche funding milestones and shareholder dilution impact.
